name: What is the typical cost to replace window weatherstripping?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost to replace window weatherstripping?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to replace window weatherstripping varies depending on the type of material, the number of windows, and the complexity of the installation. For a professional service, you might expect to pay for both materials and labor. While minor repairs can be relatively inexpensive, replacing weatherstripping on an entire house, especially with higher-quality materials, will incur a greater cost. We provide detailed estimates after assessing your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost varies based on material type, number of windows, and installation complexity. A professional assessment provides an accurate estimate.
